description: Utility functions for handling note titles in a web application, including normalization, duplicate detection, deriving titles from HTML content, and checking if a title input is user-provided.

methods.name: normalizeTitle(raw)
methods.description: Normalizes a title by trimming whitespace, collapsing internal whitespace, and adjusting case based on configuration.

methods.name: hasDuplicateTitle({ title, notes, excludeId = null })
methods.description: Checks if a duplicate title exists among notes, considering environment settings and excluding certain notes from consideration.

methods.name: deriveTitleFromContent(html, { maxLength = 80 } = {})
methods.description: Derives a title from the first non-empty line of sanitized HTML content, truncated to a maximum length.

methods.name: isUserProvidedTitle(titleState)
methods.description: Determines if a given title input is non-empty after trimming.

ctags.name: hasDuplicateTitle
ctags.pattern: /^export function hasDuplicateTitle({ title, notes, excludeId = null }) {$/
